rejected.candidate: OpenAI Businesses in ChatGPT beta announcement
rejected.reason: The announcement describes an early product beta through the official developer community, but the reviewed window did not provide a durable product specification, security architecture, administrative controls, or operating evidence sufficient for a structural enterprise-AI signal.

rejected.candidate: OpenAI API-credit promotion for ChatGPT subscriptions
rejected.reason: The offer changes commercial access for eligible users but does not change model capability, infrastructure, security, governance, or developer architecture; it is a promotion rather than an editorial signal.
The event convenes relevant stakeholders, but an event listing is not evidence of a new technical control, evaluated intervention, published methodology, or policy implementation.
The research addresses operating-system privacy and anti-cheat design rather than a material development in AI, AI agents, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or AI governance.

rejected.candidate: GitHub Copilot model retirements taking effect on 16 November
rejected.reason: The retirement date arrived in the current window, but GitHub announced the change a month earlier and no new technical evidence or migration architecture was published. Re-reporting the effective date would duplicate an already known operational notice.

rejected.candidate: Hugging Face community model, benchmark, and agent-tool posts
rejected.reason: The reviewed items were community-authored experiments and show-and-tell releases with limited samples, self-reported results, or no independent validation. None met the primary-source materiality threshold for publication.

rejected.candidate: Other Anthropic, Google DeepMind, AWS, Meta, NVIDIA, NIST, and CISA developments
rejected.reason: No new primary-source development found before the research cutoff met the exact-date, evidence, materiality, and deduplication requirements.

notes: No story or Signal Map movement was published. The live Edition 38 remains unchanged because the reviewed window produced no development strong enough to justify new coverage. This audit records a completed research window rather than manufacturing a daily headline.
